008d882a Dimensionality of the grid<br/><ul><li><c>1D</c>: Grid is a simple linear array, cells are indexed using an <code>int</code> 'x' index</li><li><c>2D</c>: Grid is a 2D array, like a texture, cells are indexed using an <code>int2</code> 'xy' index</li><li><c>3D</c>: Grid is a 3D array, like a volume texture or a vector-field, cells are indexed using an <code>int3</code> 'xyz' index</li><li><c>4D</c>: Grid is a 4D array, cells are indexed using an <code>int4</code> 'xyzw' index</li></ul>
008d8a14 Controls the runtime sampling quality of the curve. This impacts sampling performance and memory overhead:<ul><li><c>Auto</c>: Picks the best option based on the current curve data, platform, and various settings. In almost all cases you will want to keep this as the default.</li><li><c>Exact</c>: Precise, slow. No memory overhead, samples exactly the values you've setup in the curve.</li><li><c>High</c>: Precise, fast. Around 8Kb memory overhead, faster to sample than 'Exact', but slightly less precise</li><li><c>Medium</c>: Precise for most curves, very fast. Around 2Kb memory overhead, around the same speed as 'High', less precise than 'High'</li><li><c>Low</c>: Not precise, very fast. Negligible memory overhead (a couple hundred bytes), artefacts can be visible, faster to sample than all other methods</li></ul>
008d8d4f <ul><li><c>Linear</c>: Fastest interpolator. lowest quality. Turbulence abruptly changes values</li><li><c>Cubic</c>: Medium-quality interpolator. Only applicable to 'Procedural' vector-fields</li><li><c>Quintic</c>: Best-quality interpolator. produces smooth continuous turbulence. slower than Cubic. Only applicable to 'Procedural' vector-fields</li></ul>
008d8eb5 Tells the sampler what to sample<ul><li><c>Spectrum</c>: will sample the frequency spectrum of the audio channel</li><li><c>Waveform</c>: will sample the raw audio waveform</li></ul>
008d8f6c Specifies where the sampler fetches the text data<ul><li><c>Inline</c>: text is specified directly in the sampler properties</li><li><c>External</c>: sampler will load an external text file</li></ul>
008d9034 <ul><li><c>Point</c>: Fastest interpolator. lowest quality. No filtering / interpolation</li><li><c>Trilinear</c>: Interpolates between the 8 neighboring cells around the sampling point in 3D space</li><li><c>Quadrilinear</c>: Interpolates between the 16 neighboring cells around the sampling point in 4D space</li></ul>
008d9175 Determines if the sampler will sample the texture as an rgba or grayscale texture.<ul><li><c>float</c>: will sample as grayscale, the <c>sample</c> script function will return a <c>float</c></li><li><c>float4</c>: will sample as RGBA, the <c>sample</c> script function will return a <c>float4</c></li></ul>

010b28c5             },

010b294c                 contextId: currentUrl.searchParams.get('context_id') ?? "0"
010b2998             })
010b29a7         });
010b29b4         if (!response.ok) {
010b29d0             throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
010b2a17         }
010b2a22         const data = await response.json();

010b2adf             apis[endpoint] = {...endpointData, endpoint};

010b2b23     } catch (error) {
